content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Identify factors affecting the rate of photosynthesis
Explain how light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration, and temperature affect photosynthesis
Interpret graphs showing the effect of these factors
Explain the concept of limiting factors

is not constant - it varies depending on environmental conditions. Understanding what affects this rate helps farmers maximise crop yields and helps us understand plant ecology. Three main factors affect the rate: light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration, and temperature.
